notes.title: TOSS!🍌 Multiplayer update FREE for all players.
notes.notes:
It's time to go Bananas together with the FREE content update for the VR Platformer TOSS!🍌. The update is available free for all players. Today's update will introduce 3-player multiplayer and all-new content called B-sides.

Multiplayer
By far the most requested feature has been:
"I would like to play TOSS!🍌 with my friends"
"This game would be EVEN better with multiplayer"
"The game is perfect, it just needs multiplayer!"

We have listened and worked hard to enable the bananas TOSS!🍌 experience to be shared along with your friends. And you are correct... IT IS AWESOME!
Experience the full adventure, all 90+ levels, together with up to 3 other players! Create a closed room for you and your buddies or join a public room to find new friendships. Jump online and experience the world of TOSS!🍌like never before!

Cheer each other on while you race, chase, or simply free-roam the cloudscape levels together. Multiplayer allows you to play YOUR way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/3d52c3b9830bdf2bd905a3f68e3a29966abffb8e.jpg

TOSS!🍌 B-Sides - The ultimate platformer bananza!
Tossers, brace yourselves, for our latest content update, B-Sides, is here to catapult you into a whole new dimension. This freshly new update includes 3 hidden B-Side areas to the game, adding entirely new levels, rewards and whacky modifiers!
Scattered around the game are 3 sentient bananas that challenge you to grab them. If you find them – they will put you to the test!

🟡 B-Side 01 - The Tiny Testing Ground: Embark on a quest, where everything gets a bit out of scale. 
🟡 B-Side 02 - Jumbo Jungle: Go hard or go home, it is not just your hands that are getting big – The challenge is supersized too!
🟡 B-Side 03 - Stilts Showdown: Get ready to elevate your game to new heights, or is it… elongate – this one is quite literal!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/e29b9f13a7e9ac59b939acbfb455a559126a9da5.jpg

But are you ready?! These B-Sides are no picnic! They're designed for the cream of the crop, the true black belts. Think you've got what it takes?
Toss, twist, and triumph. Dare the TOSS!🍌 B-Sides now and show the world that you're not just a tosser but a tossing virtuoso! 🌟🍌

notes.title: 2022 Summer Developer Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Apes! 🐵

Together with the summer heat comes a developer update!
There's mostly just the one question on everyone's mind right now. Today, we'd like to do our best to address the [strike]elephant[/strike] gorilla in the room.

Why can't I play TOSS!🍌 yet?

(1) As some of you are aware, we are a 3-person company as well as an independent studio. As much as we love to devote ourselves to the development we also need to feed our mouths, pay for all the expenses of running a studio & take care of the overhead tasks outside of actual game production. We are a tiny - but passionate.

(2) We are still growing as both developers & as a company. This will be Agera Games' first commercial release and a large part of the work we're doing right now has to do with establishing a solid foundation for more reliable, quicker and bigger productions. This includes having a lot of meetings, waiting for big wheels to turn slowly and hoping for favorable outcomes. In other words: It's not the most exciting part of the process but we believe that once we get over this hump, there's a fun and smooth ride ahead of us.

(3) The scope & quality of the game has improved and expanded from what we initially planned. With more and better content it also takes longer to finish milestones & make improvements to the game itself. This brings us to (4).

(4) We want to deliver a polished, smooth & impactful game. We are pouring all our knowledge & expertise into this for you to receive a game we as developers can be proud of and you as community to relish and be entertained by for hours!

With all this we appreciate our community's continued patience & support. We can't wait to eventually release the game and play it along with you all!

We're also very happy to share a little bit of the new content we made for you all. Enjoy and feel free to join our Discord [LINK] to tell us what you think. 💛
